carbon_policy_signal.item: French nuclear capex constraints amid budget crunch risk defer Paks II timeline and European baseload capacity; potential EU sanctions on Rosatom fuel supply threatens long-term nuclear strategy and forces coal/gas substitution, raising EUA demand.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Delayed or sanctioned nuclear capacity forces thermal (coal/gas) dispatch into H2, raising EUA intensity per MWh; mandatory fuel-switching offsets LNG oversupply with higher-carbon generation economics.

freshness_caveat: Coal data stale as of 26-Dec (237 days old) — latest 96 USD/t and 7th-pctile rank unreliable for current merit-order positioning; Clean Dark stale as of 31-Dec (232 days old) — gas-coal spread at 27.95 EUR/MWh (47th-pctile) should not drive dispatch signals. GB Power, DE Power, Clean Spark, TTF, EUA, Storage, Renewables all current (0–2 days old) and actionable.
risk_flags: GB Power at 164.95 EUR/MWh (98th-pctile) sustained despite heat-wave volatility — supply-side fragility (grid stress, outages) likely driving premium over continental spreads.
Clean Spark 45.52 EUR/MWh (94th-pctile) persists; coal at 7th-pctile (96 USD/t, stale as of 26-Dec) signals sustained gas-in-the-money dispatch despite US record 122.5 Bcf/d production forecast.
EU Storage at 61.61% (17.1 pp below seasonal) — refill momentum only +0.39% daily; winter filling risk if geopolitical disruption hits LNG supply or demand destruction slows.
French nuclear capex crunch (Politico) may defer maintenance, risking forced outages autumn/winter; EUA could spike if coal substitution accelerates during shortage windows.

base.summary: Heat wave persists; GB/DE power volatility tight around 98th/86th-pctile; TTF stable mid-60s EUR/MWh.

downside.summary: Heat wave breaks early; US LNG export bottleneck relief shipped Q4; arbitrage normalizes; storage refill accelerates; winter risk discount compresses.

upside.summary: EU sanctions on Rosatom accelerate; Paks II delayed; French nuclear outage unplanned; coal forced baseload; EUA re-rates higher.

themes: Extreme heat-driven power demand vs. record US LNG supply glut
French nuclear budget constraints threaten EU baseload and EUA upside
Storage 17 pp below seasonal norm — refill pace sets H2 risk
Rosatom sanctions tail-risk on Paks II and EU fuel-switch economics
top_drivers: Heat-wave driven cooling demand (Europe 98th-pctile GB Power, +11.61% daily in DE) overrides US LNG record-supply bearishness; thermal merit order remains steep.
French nuclear budget crunch (Politico) raises H2 forced-outage risk; coal and gas dispatch extension supports EUA upside if sanctions or deferral materializes.
Storage 17.1 pp below seasonal normal (61.61% full) — refill pace critical; geopolitical shock (Rosatom sanctions, Iranian LNG) could trigger winter scarcity premium.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 98th-percentile amid European heat wave; Clean Spark at 94th-percentile despite record US LNG supply bearishness — thermal dispatch tightness trumps gas glut.

watchlist.why: At 98th-pctile; transmission constraints or Irish/UK renewable shortfalls could widen GB-DE spread further into Sep if heat wave persists.
Record 122.5 Bcf/d forecast clashes with historical bottlenecks; any capacity relief will depress TTF further and extend bearish arbitrage window into autumn.

watchlist.metric: French nuclear outage schedule + budget vote
watchlist.why: Politico: budget crunch delays capex; if maintenance deferred, unplanned outages in autumn force gas/coal marginal and lift EUA demand 5–10%.

watchlist.metric: Rosatom sanctions and Paks II timeline
watchlist.why: Politico: safety allegations threaten 500+ MW Hungarian baseload; EU sanctions on Russian fuel could force demand destruction or coal-pivot, impacting EUA curve shape.
Marine heat waves (Politico) amplify transmission outages and hydro volatility; peak-hour power demand spikes but ramp constraints tighten, lifting power volatility premium.

watchlist_dated.why: No explicit date in news; watch Aug–Sep for capex and outage calendar; material for autumn power and EUA curve.
